scripts.check-env: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('apps/web/.env') || !fs.existsSync('apps/api/.env')) { console.error('Error: Missing .env files in apps/web or apps/api.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run check-env && turbo run build
scripts.deploy: git add . && git commit -m 'chore: automated deployment' && git push origin main
scripts.deploy:ask: read -p 'Commit message: ' msg && git add . && git commit -m "$msg" && git push origin main
